title: Integrated SiGe Front Ends
summary: I bring on-chip antennas and low-noise electronics together in fabrication-aware silicon-germanium architectures for demanding millimeter- and submillimeter-wave systems.
problem: How can antennas and active electronics be integrated on chip without losing sight of fabrication and measurement constraints?
approach: I combine antenna and front-end design in silicon-germanium processes, moving from ideal electromagnetic models to layouts that account for process layers, feeding structures, active stages, and practical characterization. My aim is to make highly integrated architectures measurable and useful at frequencies where packaging and interconnects become part of the RF problem.

title: Antennas, Radiometry, and Measurement
summary: I study circularly polarized antennas, phased arrays, and radiometer architectures using measurement workflows spanning prototypes, probe stations, network analysis, and antenna chambers.
problem: How can extreme-frequency antenna concepts be validated when direct fabrication and measurement are unusually constrained?
approach: My research spans cavity-backed spirals, phased arrays, Fabry-Pérot cavities, and dual-circular-polarization systems. I pair simulation and fabrication-aware design with scalable prototypes, network analysis, probe-station work, frequency extenders, and chamber measurements so that performance can be tested through an appropriate physical route.

title: Space, Sensing, and Future Communications
summary: I apply high-frequency hardware to Earth observation, nanosatellite telemetry, satellite communications, automotive sensing, 6G integrated sensing, and advanced interconnects.
problem: Which integrated RF technologies can translate into compact, robust sensing and communication systems?
approach: I connect common RF methods across nanosatellite telemetry and telecommand, satellite communications, automotive radar, Earth observation, and integrated sensing and communications for 6G. My projects emphasize compact hardware, polarization, high-frequency links, and measurement strategies while keeping public industry descriptions within approved disclosure limits.
